name: BuyWhere Product Catalog
description: The only agent-native product catalog API built for Southeast Asia. Real-time search, price comparison, and deal discovery across 1M+ products from Shopee, Lazada, Amazon SG, and 50+ Singapore merchants.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Full-text product search with price, category, merchant, and region filters across 1M+ Singapore products

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get a specific product by ID including full details and current price

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Compare multiple products side-by-side: price, brand, rating, category

tools.name: get_deals
tools.description: Get discounted products sorted by discount percentage, optionally filtered by region/country

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List top-level product categories available in the BuyWhere catalog

authentication.description: Register for a free API key. Free tier: 1,000 calls/month.
